title: LLaVA-CoT: Let Vision Language Models Reason Step-by-Step
authors_zh: Guowei Xu, Peng Jin, Ziang Wu, Hao Li, Yibing Song, Lichao Sun, Li Yuan
paper_type_zh: 多模态推理示范数据集与结构化推理模型报告
best_for_zh: 适合构建或审计分阶段视觉推理 SFT 数据的读者。
one_line: LLaVA-CoT-100k turns 99k VQA pairs into four-stage summary-caption-reasoning-conclusion demonstrations for multimodal SFT.
LLaVA-CoT-100k 把 9.9 万条 VQA 样本改写为摘要、图像描述、推理和结论四阶段的多模态 SFT 示范。
why: It exposes a compact, inspectable target schema for teaching a VLM to organize perception and reasoning before answering.
inclusion_reason: LLaVA-CoT-100k serializes multimodal target behavior into four explicit rationale stages, publishes the records, and shows how they are filtered and consumed by SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
# Problem

Most visual-question-answering corpora supply a short answer but no explicit path from task interpretation through image grounding to reasoning, so supervised VLMs can jump to a conclusion before organizing the relevant evidence. This leaves builders without an inspectable target for teaching systematic multimodal reasoning.

LLaVA-CoT samples 99k image-question-answer pairs from ten VQA sources, asks GPT-4o to rewrite each answer into ordered summary, caption, reasoning, and conclusion spans, filters format and answer mismatches, and releases the resulting LLaVA-CoT-100k records for full-parameter SFT.

L4 facts: Primary source: arXiv:2411.10440; venue/date: ICCV 2025, official CVF record; decision boundary: teacher-written staged demonstrations are the Track 01 object, while SWIRES is a separate inference scaffold; atlas object/evaluation: image + question + four tagged text stages, tested on six multimodal reasoning benchmarks; collection note: L4_carded, one Track 01 category.

# 问题

多数视觉问答语料只给出短答案，没有把任务理解、图像证据定位和逐步推理显式串联起来，因此监督后的 VLM 仍可能在整理相关证据之前就跳到结论。数据构建者也缺少一种可检查的目标格式来训练系统化多模态推理。

LLaVA-CoT 从十个 VQA 来源抽取 9.9 万条图像问答，让 GPT-4o 把每条答案改写为有序的摘要、图像描述、推理和结论，过滤格式错误与答案不一致项，并公开 LLaVA-CoT-100k 记录用于全参数 SFT。

L4 facts：主要来源：arXiv:2411.10440；venue/date：ICCV 2025，CVF 官方记录；判定边界：Track 01 对象是教师编写的分阶段示范，SWIRES 属于独立的推理时脚手架；atlas 对象/评测：图像 + 问题 + 四个带标签文本阶段，在六个多模态推理 benchmark 上评测；收录说明：L4_carded，仅一个 Track 01 分类。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
# Core idea

LLaVA-CoT changes a VQA target from one answer into an ordered, tagged demonstration whose summary plans the task, caption grounds relevant visual evidence, reasoning derives the answer, and conclusion matches the source label. GPT-4o authors the trace, exact-tag parsing plus a semantic answer judge provide the selection signal, and Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct is the SFT consumer; this is instruction/demonstration/rationale data rather than a reward-model or benchmark contribution.

Google Scholar citations: 577（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=LLaVA-CoT%3A+Let+Vision+Language+Models+Reason+Step-by-Step&author=Guowei+Xu&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: LLaVA-CoT-100k Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Xkev/LLaVA-CoT-100k Scale: 99k image-question-answer records from ten VQA sources Record form: image reference, question, original answer, and tagged SUMMARY, CAPTION, REASONING, and CONCLUSION text File / storage format: JSON on Hugging Face Domains / languages: English general VQA, charts, documents, geometry, science, social context, and synthetic visual reasoning Construction and filtering: GPT-4o writes all stages; a parser enforces tags and a GPT-4o judge rejects refusals or conclusion/answer mismatch License / access constraints: Apache-2.0 dataset metadata; upstream image and VQA-source terms still apply Intended use: multimodal SFT, rationale distillation, structured-output analysis, and visual-reasoning data audits

# 核心思想

LLaVA-CoT 把单一 VQA 答案改造成有序、带标签的示范：摘要规划任务，图像描述定位相关视觉证据，推理阶段推导答案，结论与来源标签一致。GPT-4o 编写轨迹，精确标签解析与语义答案 judge 提供筛选信号，Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct 是 SFT 消费者；它属于 instruction/demonstration/rationale 数据，而不是奖励模型或 benchmark 贡献。

Google Scholar 引用数：577（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=LLaVA-CoT%3A+Let+Vision+Language+Models+Reason+Step-by-Step&author=Guowei+Xu&hl=en）

开放数据集：是 数据集名称：LLaVA-CoT-100k 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Xkev/LLaVA-CoT-100k 规模：来自十个 VQA 来源的 9.9 万条图像问答记录 记录形式：图像引用、问题、原始答案，以及带 SUMMARY、CAPTION、REASONING、CONCLUSION 标签的文本 文件/存储格式：Hugging Face 上的 JSON 领域/语言：英文通用 VQA、图表、文档、几何、科学、社会情境与合成视觉推理 构造与筛选：GPT-4o 编写全部阶段；解析器检查标签，GPT-4o judge 排除拒答或结论与标准答案不一致的记录 许可/访问约束：数据集元数据为 Apache-2.0；仍需遵守上游图像与 VQA 来源条款 预期用途：多模态 SFT、rationale 蒸馏、结构化输出分析与视觉推理数据审计

title: Method
方法
html:
# Method

  1. Assemble VQA seeds. Input: ten general and science-focused image-QA datasets. Operation: sample records while retaining each image, question, and standard answer. Output and transition: 99k source pairs enter rationale generation. Check / stop rule: a record needs a usable image, question, and reference answer.
  2. Write ordered demonstrations. Input: one source pair and a fixed four-stage prompt. Operation: GPT-4o writes SUMMARY, CAPTION, REASONING, and CONCLUSION spans in that order. Output and transition: a tagged multimodal response enters validation. Check / stop rule: the conclusion is instructed to match the standard answer exactly in substance.
  3. Validate and release records. Input: generated response and source answer. Operation: parse the four tag pairs, extract the conclusion, and ask GPT-4o whether it is a refusal or differs meaningfully from the standard answer. Output and transition: accepted JSON records form LLaVA-CoT-100k. Check / stop rule: reject missing/malformed stages, refusals, and semantic answer mismatch.
  4. Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct and accepted demonstrations. Operation: full-parameter SFT for three epochs, then optionally apply reward-model-guided SWIRES over semantic stages at inference. Output and transition: LLaVA-CoT predictions and benchmark scores. Check / stop rule: SFT uses the fixed tagged target; SWIRES stops after accepted stage candidates or its retracing cap.

Reproducibility: verify the official JSON revision, source-dataset lineage, generation and verification prompts, parser, model checkpoint, and SWIRES code. Fix the GPT-4o version, source record IDs/images, prompt text, judge decision, random seed 42, three-epoch training setup, reward model, and inference budget; generation temperature, total teacher tokens/cost, and semantic-judge error rates are not reported.

# 方法

  1. 汇集 VQA 种子。输入：十个通用与科学视觉问答数据集。操作：抽样并保留每条记录的图像、问题和标准答案。输出与流转：9.9 万条来源问答进入 rationale 生成。检查/停止规则：记录必须有可用图像、问题与参考答案。
  2. 编写有序示范。输入：一条来源问答与固定四阶段提示。操作：GPT-4o 依次写出 SUMMARY、CAPTION、REASONING 和 CONCLUSION。输出与流转：带标签的多模态回答进入验证。检查/停止规则：结论在语义上必须与标准答案一致。
  3. 验证并发布记录。输入：生成回答与来源答案。操作：解析四对标签、抽取结论，再让 GPT-4o 判断它是否拒答或与标准答案存在实质差异。输出与流转：通过的 JSON 记录组成 LLaVA-CoT-100k。检查/停止规则：缺失/畸形阶段、拒答和语义答案不一致均被剔除。
  4. 训练并评测消费者。输入：Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct 与通过筛选的示范。操作：进行三轮全参数 SFT，推理时可选用奖励模型引导的 SWIRES 在语义阶段上搜索。输出与流转：LLaVA-CoT 预测与 benchmark 分数。检查/停止规则：SFT 使用固定标签目标；SWIRES 在出现可接受阶段候选或达到回溯上限时停止。

可复现性：需核验官方 JSON revision、来源数据谱系、生成/验证提示、解析器、模型 checkpoint 与 SWIRES 代码。复现时固定 GPT-4o 版本、来源记录 ID/图像、提示文本、judge 判定、随机种子 42、三轮训练设置、奖励模型与推理预算；生成温度、教师总 token/成本和语义 judge 错误率未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
# Evidence

Claim: the ordered rationale target, rather than extra teacher text alone, is useful supervision. Controlled setup: Appendix Table 7 trains the same Llama-3.2-Vision backbone with the released data under multi-task targets, shuffled stage order, or the intended ordered CoT target. Result: the six-benchmark reasoning average is 57.7 for multi-task supervision, 58.2 for shuffled stages, and 63.1 for ordered LLaVA-CoT, with MMVet-R rising from 58.0/54.3 to 66.7. Boundary: this supports the reported target order and CoT formulation on one 11B backbone; teacher quality, source mixture, and inference choices remain coupled, and final-answer agreement does not validate each rationale step.

# 证据

主张：有效监督来自有序 rationale 目标，而不只是增加教师文本。受控设置：附录表 7 在同一 Llama-3.2-Vision backbone 上，分别使用多任务目标、打乱阶段顺序的目标和预期的有序 CoT 目标训练。结果：六项推理 benchmark 平均分分别为 57.7、58.2 和 63.1，MMVet-R 则从 58.0/54.3 提升到 66.7。边界：结果支持该 11B backbone 上报告的阶段顺序与 CoT 形式；教师质量、来源混合和推理设置仍有耦合，最终答案一致也不能验证每个中间步骤。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
# Novelty

Earlier VQA instruction sets usually preserve a question and direct answer, while multimodal CoT prompting often leaves the stage structure implicit. LLaVA-CoT changes the training object into four explicitly ordered and tagged targets that separate planning, relevant visual description, derivation, and final response. This makes stage identity trainable and inspectable and lets inference search operate at semantic boundaries rather than fixed token spans. GPT-4o distillation, SFT, beam-style search, and final-answer filtering are not individually new; the direction signal is their alignment around a released staged-rationale record.

# 新意

以往 VQA instruction 数据通常只保留问题和直接答案，多模态 CoT prompting 也常把阶段结构留在隐式文本中。LLaVA-CoT 把训练对象改成四个显式有序、带标签的目标，分别承担规划、相关视觉描述、推导和最终回答。这样既能训练和检查阶段身份，也能让推理搜索以语义边界而非固定 token 区间为单位。GPT-4o 蒸馏、SFT、类 beam 搜索和最终答案过滤本身并不新；方向信号来自它们围绕公开分阶段 rationale 记录的统一设计。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
# Limitations

  • Author-stated limitation: SWIRES can get lost or hallucinate when an image is too complex for the model's visual understanding; audit failures by image complexity and compare no-search versus retracing outputs.
  • Curator audit risk: the same teacher family writes rationales and judges conclusion alignment, so correlated mistakes can pass; sample intermediate captions/reasoning for independent human or model review.
  • Curator audit risk: the paper does not report semantic decontamination across ten VQA sources and evaluation sets; compare image hashes, question text, and paraphrase embeddings before training or claiming transfer.

# 局限

  • 作者明确局限：当图像过于复杂、超出模型视觉理解能力时，SWIRES 可能在回溯中迷失或产生幻觉；应按图像复杂度审计失败，并对比不开启搜索与回溯输出。
  • Curator 审计风险：同一教师家族既编写 rationale 又判断结论一致性，相关错误可能共同通过；应由独立人工或模型抽查中间 caption 与 reasoning。
  • Curator 审计风险：论文没有报告十个 VQA 来源与评测集之间的语义去污染；训练或声称迁移前应比较图像哈希、问题文本与释义 embedding。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
# Usefulness

  • Multimodal SFT builder: use the released JSON records to teach an existing VLM an explicit plan-ground-reason-answer target; output a checkpoint and report both stage-format compliance and task accuracy.
  • Data auditor: compare source answers with conclusions, then independently score visual grounding and rationale faithfulness rather than accepting the release judge alone.
  • Do not use when: upstream image licenses cannot be satisfied, the target requires non-disclosed internal chains rather than exposed traces, or the application cannot tolerate teacher-authored unfaithful rationales.

# 用途

  • 多模态 SFT 构建者：用公开 JSON 记录训练现有 VLM 的显式“规划—定位—推理—回答”目标；输出 checkpoint，同时报告阶段格式合规率与任务准确率。
  • 数据审计者：先比对来源答案与结论，再独立评估视觉 grounding 和 rationale 忠实度，不能只接受发布方 judge。
  • 不适用情形：无法满足上游图像许可、目标要求隐藏推理而非公开轨迹，或应用无法容忍教师编写的不忠实 rationale 时不应直接使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
# Reading notes

  • Positioning: the main data contribution is 99k four-stage visual reasoning demonstrations, not SWIRES itself.
  • Method handle: source VQA pair, GPT-4o staged writing, tag parsing, and semantic conclusion checking determine the released record.
  • Data/artifact handle: public Apache-2.0 JSON records expose summary, caption, reasoning, and conclusion targets; upstream source terms still need review.
  • Evidence anchor: ordered CoT reaches a 63.1 six-benchmark average versus 57.7 multi-task and 58.2 shuffled-stage supervision in Appendix Table 7.
  • Reuse decision: use for staged multimodal SFT only after independent rationale, provenance, license, and decontamination audits.

# 阅读笔记

  • 定位：主要数据贡献是 9.9 万条四阶段视觉推理示范，而不是 SWIRES 本身。
  • 方法抓手：来源 VQA 问答、GPT-4o 分阶段编写、标签解析和语义结论检查共同决定公开记录。
  • 数据/Artifact 抓手：Apache-2.0 的公开 JSON 暴露摘要、图像描述、推理和结论目标；仍需检查上游来源条款。
  • 证据锚点：附录表 7 中，有序 CoT 的六项平均分为 63.1，而多任务和乱序阶段监督分别为 57.7 与 58.2。
  • 复用决定：只在完成独立 rationale、provenance、许可和去污染审计后，用于分阶段多模态 SFT。
